post_title: !!! Question about Tools in the Toolbars
post_details: I'm really new to CLO and i've been watching some of the video tutorials on youtube but i'm having a hard time with my toolbars. Some of the tools are there but the others dont show unless i hover over little double arrows but i can never click on them when i move my mouse. not sure if that makes sense. i guess what im asking is how do i show all of my tools in the toolbars so that those double arrows aren't there anymore.

comments.comment_body: Hello 428973901453, There are 2 settings to check to change how your toolbars display. Both can be found in Settings --&gt User Settings --&gt User interface. Under the Toolbar header, you can adjust where your toolbars appear. Depending on the size and ratio of your screen, having the bars on the side vs top may give you an orientation where all tools are displayed without having to do that. The 2nd option is in that same section, and it is a check box called Group tools. This will collapse more tools together into a single icon. If all your tools are ungrouped, you may want to group them so you have less icons in the bars. They will all still be available, just consolidated! Another recommendation I have is to learn the hot keys, that way you don't even have to find the icons at all. You can change and set new hot keys if you don't like what is set by default in Settings --&gt User Settings --&gt Shortcuts. Happy CLOing :)
Thank you for your help!

I know this is a late comment, but I've figured a workaround to this issue. 1st click on the bars next to each tool group and drag the tools out to create a new row. Should look like this... 2nd If the tools are taking up too much space, you can simply hide the ones you don't want to see: It's a bit tasky, but worth the effort (avoid reseting to default layout, don't wanna waste ur efforts)

post_title: Autosewing has stopped working for darts and pleats
post_details: Hello! I am currently working on version 6.0.460. I am having a problem with the Auto Sewing Tool. I'm trying to sew darts and pleats as shown in the YouTube webinar. But the Auto Sewing Tool is inactive (screenshot attached). Everything definitely worked correctly on the same project in version 6.0.328. Is this just a some kind of bug or has something changed in the way the tool works? Thank you Hanna

comments.comment_body: Hi 418331616813, If you arrange the pieces around an avatar, does the autosewing become active? It is calculated based on the arrangement points the pieces are put on, so without that information autosewing will not be available!

Thanks for the quick response! If you arrange the pieces around an avatar, does the autosewing become active? Yes. Autosewing becomes active and works correctly in this case. It is calculated based on the arrangement points the pieces are put on, so without that information autosewing will not be available! I have to disagree, because according to the information provided in the official webinar, this function can be also used to automatically stitch darts and pleats on patterns that are in a flat state in a 3D window. I mean sewing darts and pleats as shown in this webinar https://youtu.be/jyfAGfcig5k starting from the 59:15 and 1:04:28 minute. This is what I'm trying to follow in my project and this function worked in version 6.0.328 and stopped working in 6.0.460.

Hi 418331616813, For autosewing, the seamlines are calculated based directly on the bounding volumes where they are placed, which is also mentioned in the webinar at the beginning of the autosewing section. I checked back with the team, you need to have an avatar added to the space for this other feature to work, even if you do not have the pieces arranged when using autosewing. Once you add an avatar, the Autosew feature should become active! To have pleats sewn automatically, make sure that the fold lines are internals and the fold angles are applied.

comments.comment_body: Hello 367588093633, Thanks for the feedback! This is a newer feature, so we are still developing it further! As far as using poses from DAZ, the avatar converter is giving an avatar the CLO rig, so you will only be able to use the poses and motion from the CLO library. If you want to use DAZ poses in CLO, you can do the following: Export the Avatar from DAZ as and OBJ with the textures/etc. Change the pose in DAZ and export as FBX. The settings depend on a lot of factors, but we recommend to export in Binary SDK version 2010 IMPORT the FBX file in a blank CLO document, then save as a POSE (File, Save As, Pose). Close CLO document, do not save IMPORT Avatar OBJ into blank CLO document. Apply new pose as normal.

Thank you! Appreciate the feedback and glad to hear you are going to develop further. Hi 367588093633, No problem! Yes that's correct, DAZ poses cannot be applied to CLO avatars because they are using different rigging, so at the moment you must choose between CLO and DAZ rigging :)
